description: Flood prone areas 2020 is a hazard data set listed in SODMA open data portal (Somalia and Greater Horn of Africa disaster risk data), a disaster risk data portal, published or maintained by SWALIM. This layer shows flood prone areas derived from radar images (Sentinel 1) and optical images (Sentinel 2, Landsat, and Maxar VHR images) acquired during the period 2018-2020. The analysis was performed by FAO Somalia Water and Land Information Management (SWALIM). Coverage: Africa (the listing does not name one country). The portal files it under the publisher SWALIM. Its tags are 2020, floods, juba, prone, river. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, PNG. The portal shows 2025-06-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sodma-somalia-disaster-risk-data-portal.
